task.description: REWORK ITERATION 1: Address blocking test gaps reported by TEST-RUNNER for EXT-03. Add and wire executable EXT-03 integration tests covering TC-EXT-03-INT-01..10 into the integration suite entrypoint so these scenarios are actually executed. Keep tests deterministic and aligned with tests/specs/EXT-03.md. Also resolve or explicitly account for coverage-step expectations so subsequent TEST-RUNNER execution can produce non-partial verification.

Spec-defined EXT-03 integration IDs are mapped to executable cases
No flaky/time-dependent behavior in added tests
Handoff result includes updated artifacts and no unresolved MAJOR coverage gaps
